issues: 回弹弹簧过冲把 gap 拉成负数（约 −5px），链接块互相重叠、徽章读数变成 0，是明显穿帮
顶部 "GAP" 大字 + 黑块读数是调试占位，画面不像在设计工具里调参数
链接块里只有灰色骨架条，2px 灰边，读不出是导航
框选描边与手柄是 3px 深灰粗线、16px 手柄，标注线 3px 实心，工具语义笨重
跳数脉冲按帧号 sin 摆动，与数值是否在变化无关；背景是平灰底 + 均匀点阵
changes: 弹簧参数不变，过冲段 ×0.45 压缩：12→110→约 4→12，仍"缩到比起点更紧再回稳"但 gap 永不为负
读数块做成 Auto layout 检查器：方向切换、Gap 数值框（选中蓝描边 + 4px 焦点环）+ 随 gap 滚动的拨盘刻度尺，与块位置同源同帧
链接块换成真实导航文案（Overview 深色激活态 + 4 个白色胶囊，30px 字），发丝线、顶部内高光、两层软阴影，入场 0–12f 错峰上浮
框选改为 2px 选择蓝 + 14px 白底手柄（spring 依次弹出）+ 图层名 "Nav links"；测量改为间距粉：虚线延长线、2px 测量线带端刺、粉色徽章
跳数脉冲改为由数值相位驱动（每跨 2px 一格脉冲一次）× 速度门限，静止时归 1；背景换柔光渐变 + 中心清晰、四周隐去的点阵
issuesEn: The return spring overshoots gap to about −5px, so the link blocks overlap and the badges read 0, a visible glitch
The big "GAP" title with a black readout chip is a debug placeholder; nothing says you're tuning a value inside a design tool
Link blocks are grey skeleton bars with 2px grey borders, so they don't read as navigation
Selection outline and handles are 3px dark grey lines with 16px handles and 3px solid measure lines, which feels clumsy as tool UI
The tick pulse wobbles on a frame-based sine whether or not the value is changing; the background is flat grey with a uniform dot grid
changesEn: Same spring parameters, overshoot portion scaled ×0.45: 12→110→about 4→12, still tighter than the start before settling, but gap never goes negative

Readout rebuilt as an Auto layout inspector: direction toggle, Gap number field (selection-blue stroke + 4px focus ring) and a dial ruler that scrolls with gap, all from the same value in the same frame
Blocks carry real nav labels (dark active Overview + four white pills, 30px type) with hairlines, top highlight, two-layer soft shadows and a 0–12f staggered rise-in

Selection is now a 2px selection-blue frame with 14px white handles that spring in one after another and a "Nav links" layer name; measurements use spacing pink: dashed extension lines, 2px measure line with end ticks, pink badges
Tick pulse is driven by the value's phase (one pulse per 2px step) gated by speed, so it rests at 1; background is a soft-light gradient with a dot grid that fades toward the edges
